title: Recombee pricing - Free tier plus tiered plans from $99 to $2,499/month
clean_text: Recombee offers a free plan covering up to 100,000 recommendation requests per month, making it accessible for small businesses to test. Paid tiers include Standard at $99 per month, Plus at $899 per month, Pro at $1,499 per month, and Premium at $2,499 per month, with a 30-day free trial available across paid plans. Pricing scales primarily with usage volume and feature access rather than catalog size alone.
